Endurance training increases the muscle's capacity to use oxygen and produce energy aerobically, through more mitochondria, greater capillary density, and higher oxidative enzyme activity. Of the two options the team listed, neither matches this directly. "Break down phosphocreatine" is the closer one, since it's an energy-system capacity, but it is the anaerobic system that endurance training mainly affects less. I'd pick "break down phosphocreatine" only because the answer must be one of the two, and I'm not confident in that pick.

CONFIDENCE: 30
